text: London's Metropolitan Police summoned five Chelsea fans over a racist incident before last month's Champions League match against Paris Saint-Germain, after video showed them blocking a black man from boarding a Metro train and chanting racist slogans. The men face football banning order hearings at Waltham Forest Magistrates' Court, while Chelsea suspended them and condemned the behavior.
